host.description: Fully qualified domain name for ARSnova, like 'arsnova.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

admin_email.title: Administrator account
admin_email.description: E-mail address of a registered ARSnova user that should be granted administrator rights. Leave empty to keep everyone a regular user.

allow_registration.title: Allow self-registration
allow_registration.description: Allow anyone to create a new account from the login page. Off on a new instance; when omitted, the current setting stays. Existing and AD/LDAP logins work either way.

smtp_host.title: Manual SMTP relay host
smtp_host.description: Fallback plain SMTP relay (port 25, no authentication) used only when no cluster smarthost is configured. Leave empty to rely on the cluster smarthost.

smtp_from.title: Mail sender address
smtp_from.description: Sender address for ARSnova e-mails. Defaults to arsnova@<domain>.

ldap_enabled.title: Enable AD/LDAP login
ldap_enabled.description: Allow login with directory accounts (a user domain of this cluster or an LDAP server of its own).

ldap_url.title: LDAP URL
ldap_url.description: ldap_source custom: URL of the directory server, e.g. ldaps://dc.example.org:636 (StartTLS is not supported by ARSnova).

ldap_base_dn.title: Base DN
ldap_base_dn.description: ldap_source custom: search base, e.g. DC=ad,DC=example,DC=org

ldap_bind_dn.title: Bind DN
ldap_bind_dn.description: ldap_source custom: service account used to search the directory.

ldap_bind_password.title: Bind password
ldap_bind_password.description: ldap_source custom: password of the service account. Empty keeps the stored password; never returned by get-configuration.

ldap_group.title: Access group
ldap_group.description: Only members may log in (Active Directory, nested groups count): a group name, or a DN for ldap_source custom. Empty: every directory user.

ldap_user_attribute.title: Login attribute
ldap_user_attribute.description: ldap_source custom: login attribute. Empty: sAMAccountName (ad) or uid (rfc2307).

ldap_title.title: Provider label
ldap_title.description: Label shown on the login page for this provider. Defaults to 'AD'.

ldap_source.title: Directory
ldap_source.description: domain: a user domain of this cluster (recommended, no credentials stored in the module); custom: an LDAP server of its own.

ldap_domain.title: User domain
ldap_domain.description: Name of the user domain (ldap_source domain).

ldap_start_tls.title: StartTLS
ldap_start_tls.description: Not supported by ARSnova: must be false.

ldap_tls_verify.title: Verify the server certificate
ldap_tls_verify.description: ldap_source custom with ldaps: check the certificate against the public CAs and the host name. false: trust the certificate the server presents (renewed at every start), no host name check.

ldap_schema.title: Directory type
ldap_schema.description: ldap_source custom: ad (Active Directory, Samba) or rfc2307 (OpenLDAP).
